\caption{All outcomes and support strata for the added evaluation. Counts pool the ten seeds descriptively: every row has 1,000 episodes. S/U/D/M/T denote safe completion, unsafe intact completion, destructive completion, mechanical failure and timeout; these five counts sum to 1,000. For SNAP, D includes completed episodes with fracture or accumulated damage; broken-latch timeouts remain T (Table~\ref{tab:snap-ood-attribution}). V counts episodes with outcome-affecting violations and can overlap those categories. The final columns give safe completions/episodes within and outside training support; n/a means an empty stratum. The same 100 reset draws are reused across training seeds and arms within each task/condition, so pooled episodes are not independent training replicates. Raw seed counts, rates and all paired-arm intervals accompany the source data.}\label{tab:ood-outcomes}\\
